title: phlomoides sogdiana
intro: Phlomoides sogdiana, commonly known as Sogdian lavender, is a plant species within the family Lamiaceae. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including its ability to reduce inflammation and promote relaxation. The therapeutic actions of Phlomoides sogdiana include its sedative and antispasmodic properties, which may help alleviate anxiety and muscle spasms. The bioactive constituents of this plant include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and essential oils, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
